audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Zed all 7 stages while Lux wins 52.38% over 3797 games, and the full-layer phases[0..3].why already described Lux winning those stages — the row and the sentence under it disagreed.
audit.why: Lux Q is 1175 range and E 1100; Zed's Razor Shuriken is 900 and Living Shadow only 650. She out-ranges him by 275 before he has a shadow to threaten with, so levels 1-5 are hers; the lane flips at Death Mark (120s at rank 1) and again on his first lethality item.
audit.corrected: Lux takes rows 0-3 (Levels 1 through 4-5); Zed takes rows 4-6 (Level 6, first item, 2+ items). Both layers moved together.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose put Lux's Final Spark spike at 6 as the lane-deciding moment while the chart said Zed; the real level-6 swing here is Death Mark.
audit.why: Death Mark is 120/110/100s and makes Zed untargetable on the dash, so it lands through a Prismatic Barrier timed early. Lux's own R is 60/50/40s — two answers per one of his, which is the actual spike story.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the 120s Death Mark and the shield timing; phases[5] names his lethality item; phases[6] names the fog Death Mark threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never named a single Zed ability (packet defect) and breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Razor Shuriken (Q) 6s, Living Shadow (W) 20/19/18/17/16s, Shadow Slash (E) 5/4.5/4/3.5/3s, Death Mark (R) 120/110/100s. Living Shadow is his only escape; when the shadow is spent he cannot leave a landed Light Binding. Death Mark's dash is untargetable, so a barrier spent before the mark lands is wasted.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with real numbers; whys and phase text now name Razor Shuriken, Living Shadow, Shadow Slash and Death Mark.

audit.why: Whether Prismatic Barrier or Zhonya's is the correct answer to a landed Death Mark, and whether Cleanse affects it, is not stated in Riot's text and I did not assert it.

edits.before: Final Spark online — anything the root catches dies to the laser math. The lane becomes a geometry quiz.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-E-R deletes squishies from root range. Force him to dodge or die on every contact.
edits.after: His first lethality item makes the shadow Q pair lethal, and you have no dash to sidestep both at once.

edits.before: Late Lux decides fights from a screen away: root the entry, slow the pit, and laser the clump your team froze.
edits.after: He can Death Mark you from fog at any moment, so warding your flank, not dueling, is what keeps you alive.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. It governs your forward steps. - W Prismatic Barrier spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Death Mark is 120s at rank 1 — his commit window, and your R is 60s, so you get two answers per one of his. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1: if the shadow is spent he cannot escape your Q. - Shadow Slash is 5s — chip, not a threat.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Zed opens from a flank with Living Shadow's 650-range dash — a warded side and a centered wave force his 900 Q through minions to reach you.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Detonating for one more tick keeps you standing still inside his 900 Q range — take the chip you have and step back behind the wave.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Zed wins by W-dashing behind you, marking you, and cashing the burst in the 3 seconds before Death Mark pops.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry by being the range Zed cannot reach: Final Spark reaches 3340 and his Death Mark only 625, so join fights from outside his jump.
